description: Rebuilt 29-10-2026 from VATSIM Switzerland's vACC 'Preferential Runway System' page (vacc.ch), which gives exact runway pairs, local-time windows and a tailwind threshold, matching a real LSZH arrival ATIS sample exactly -- unlike the retracted first version of this pack, built from Zurich Airport's own vaguer 'Operating Concepts' page. Ids use the project's usual runway-coded form (as YSSY/NFFN do), not an airport concept name -- a bare 'General' id collided with an unrelated word in src/traffic/parseFeed.ts, which the airport-literal check correctly caught. Full sourcing, the ATIS cross-check and every simplification are in docs/LSZH_RUNWAY_RESEARCH.md: 14A10D/34A10D are low-confidence (no threshold found, not in the ATIS sample); settings.json's one tailwind limit (7 kt) stands in for the vACC page's separate 10 kt (RWY14) / 7 kt (RWY28) figures; no crosswind threshold was found; atisWording is the project's generic default, not LSZH's real (free-text) ATIS style.

modes.description: vACC 'General' (daytime default): arrivals 14, departures 28. Matches the live ATIS sample exactly.
Daytime, strong north-easterly wind (Zurich Airport's own page; not in the vACC page, no threshold found): arrivals 14, departures 10
Evening, strong north-easterly wind (Zurich Airport's own page; not in the vACC page, no threshold found): arrivals 34, departures 10

atisWording.source: project default -- the real ATIS sample uses 'ARRIVALS'/'DEP' and different sentence structure entirely (free text, not a runway/for/and template), so this field does not really apply to LSZH's ATIS style; kept for schema compatibility only
